thread:
marta: Heads-up — getting KMS decrypt failures in staging when we run helm chart (creates SA + annotation) at the same time as a terraform apply that creates the IRSA role/grant. Anyone seen an IRSA+KMS race like this? stack: k8s 1.24, terraform aws provider 5.x
raj: yup, this is a pretty common timing window. error looks like AccessDenied for kms:Decrypt on the pod assume-role arn?
emma: can you paste the exact error from the pod logs?
marta: paste: 
```
E0323 10:12:11.345 kubelet: 2026-03-23T10:12:11Z stderr F aws-kms: AccessDeniedException: user: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/eks-pod-sa-role/i-abc123 is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
raj: that matches the flow where the pod tries to use the role before the KMS grant/key policy allows the role ARN. TF often creates role and then grant, but helm can annotate SA first so the pod gets creds earlier.
ben: short fixes: 1) create the KMS grant/key policy earlier (apply TF before helm), 2) add a small retry in init container, or 3) use depended ordering: make helm_release depend on the aws_kms_grant/role resources.
ops-bot: "pipeline: terraform apply failed on staging - error creating aws_kms_grant: AccessDenied (policy constraint) — see job logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/1234"
marta: looks like our pipeline runs terraform and helm in parallel to speed deploys. happy path is split apply + deploy but we want minimal downtime. thoughts on model: have TF create role+grant first, then helm?
raj: I'd do a two-step apply: TF infra -> CI gate -> helm deploy. If we need atomic single pipeline, add a pre-apply step that ensures KMS grant exists (or a dummy grant), or add a small wait loop in helm chart post-install hook that verifies decrypt works.
emma: another pattern: put an explicit depends_on in helm_release resource (registry/helm provider) pointing at aws_iam_role.irsa_role and aws_kms_grant.irsa_decrypt so terraform orchestrates the order. downside: couples charts with infra tf modules.
ben: also ensure the KMS key policy allows the principal type used. For IRSA the grantee is the IAM role ARN. If you use session tags/source identity, add condition to key policy: 
```
Condition = {
  StringLike = { "aws:PrincipalArn" = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/*svc-*" }
}
```
This helps limit scope.
marta: thanks. I'll open a quick PR to change the pipeline to run terraform infra stage before helm for staging, and add a follow-up to add depends_on in prod if needed.
raj: ping me on the PR, I can add the terraform snippet and a note about adding sts:SourceIdentity check if we want tighter constraints.
emma: +1. also add a small readiness check in the chart to surface decrypt errors early.
ben: fwiw, I filed infra ticket INFRA-789 to add a reusable module that creates role+grant with proper ordering and tests.
marta: awesome — i'll split the staging deploy for now and report back. cc @raj @emma :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
emma: :rocket:
